name: How long does tile wall installation usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does tile wall installation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timing depends on the size of the wall, the tile format, and how much prep is required. A small backsplash may take a day or two, while a full shower or accent wall can take several days once drying, grouting, and any waterproofing are included. In the Denver area, weather usually matters less indoors, but project delays can still happen if wall repair or material selection is not settled early.
acceptedAnswer.description: Small walls can take 1–2 days, while larger or wetter areas may take several days. Extra prep, waterproofing, or repairs add time.
